name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring acreage expansion calibrated to 14-16 plots, unthrottled 10-hand workforce acceleration, active-quota town shop fulfillment through late game, strict agronomic lifespan phase-gates, cluster harvesting transit optimization, and corrected livestock feed reserves.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand quotas, uncultivated plot counts, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and delivers mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) through step 712 to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed, active shop contracts, and triggering complete terminal clearance at step 714.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump vulnerable uncommitted commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into unthrottled workforce acceleration (10-hand rush), contiguous land expansion up to 14-16 plots, commercial high-yield seeds under agronomic phase-gates, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: cluster harvesting mature crops, bulk worker drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, phase-gated planting, and terminal field clearance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery contracts.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (active_shop_demand > 0 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.30 + 180.0 and day <= 27)) and step <= 712
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) within agronomic maturation windows when surplus cash covers seed costs and 1.30x midnight payroll reserve.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.30x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 88%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows; cease shop seed purchases beyond day 27.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.70 * base_price; only relax floor to 0.45 * base_price if shed_used >= 95 to prevent discard drops. At step >= 714, liquidate all remaining inventory unconditionally for complete terminal cash realization.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price during transient shed spikes; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); protect inventory committed to active town shop contract quotas unless shed strictly exceeds 94% emergency saturation.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable, uncommitted commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices; protect inventory quantities actively matched to open town shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contract quotas.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 250.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or total_plots < 16 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and step <= 708
attributes.guidance: Prioritize capital deployment: 1) Rush hired hands to the 10-hand cap as top priority without artificial pacing; 2) Acquire contiguous land plots up to a calibrated ceiling of 14-16 plots when uncultivated_plots <= 1 and cash covers purchase plus 1.35x wage buffer and seed capital; 3) Procure commercial seeds and fertilizer under strict agronomic phase-gates (halt Pumpkins at Day 24, halt Tomatoes at Day 26, halt Carrots at Day 28, halt all buying at step 708).
attributes.pitfalls: Never allocate reinvestment capital if net cash after purchase drops below 1.35x midnight wage buffer; do not acquire land beyond 16 plots to avoid labor dilution; do not purchase long-cycle seeds past their phase-gate deadlines; never throttle early hand hiring.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Cluster harvesting: harvest mature crops on current and contiguous plots until carrying capacity is reached or cluster is exhausted before returning to shed; 2) Drop off full carried inventory at shed; 3) Water dry planted crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercial seeds matching phase-gates; 6) Till and weed only on active expansion plots. Shift 100% of hands to terminal harvesting and shed haulage at step >= 708 to ensure complete shed delivery by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never drop off single items at the shed when adjacent mature crops remain unharvested; never prioritize weeding or tilling over harvesting or watering; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
